api.notes: Martensite derived camera-animation transport: actual Source/Base storage accepts subclasses, dispatches native virtual lifecycle/camera atoms, rereads the live animation slot after callbacks, and preserves borrowed endpoint/view references plus exact intrusive counts. 198 pinned native CPU records and seven prior live-animation alias rows replay replacement/null/restore, failure order and actual camera states. Concrete widget GPU captures use a real derived camera source on both devices. Whole classes remain partial; strict raster failures remain unaccepted. See docs/ais-view-cube-animation-source.md and porting/runtime-evidence/view-cube-animation-source/.
